criteria.finding: The v1.1.10 publisher workflow AAB is pinned by SHA-256 and size. Bundletool 1.18.3 produced an installable universal APK from that AAB; the derived APK uses the public laboratory fixture signature and is identified separately from a store-signed production APK.

The exact release payload reports app.metanet.explorer 1.1.10 (66) and follows the ordinary production first-run flow. Re-signing the universal derivative changes Android signer identity, so signer-dependent behavior is outside this run.
The application ran from cleared package state in the dedicated TPNIL_API_36 emulator. The AVD definition, Android properties, toolchain and installed package state are retained.
The ordinary first-run path requires phone-number verification before the wallet service boundary becomes available. No personal phone number or undisclosed pre-provisioned identity was introduced.
Wallet initialization did not pass the ordinary phone verification boundary, so controlled fixture funding was not applicable to this run.

Native launch, package identity, the first-run verification barrier, browser navigation to the pinned ToDo webroot and its explicit wallet-required result were observed. Wallet-backed V002 through V008 remained blocked by initialization.
One clean Android execution is retained. A second execution requires an admitted activation fixture or supported pre-provisioned wallet state.
The laboratory retains the digest, source provenance and observations. An accepted artifact-submission grant for indefinite redistribution of the publisher AAB remains outstanding.
